decision: Reuse existing project VCA/denoise/SSConv/HGCN blocks, loss and continuation code. Independently implement a small geometry-only centroid4NN union and published symmetric normalization. No external code, trainer, split, dependency or data incorporated. No upstream reproduction claimed.
control_limits: Q is the same frozen train-label-LDA/SLIC assignment in every arm; only newly built ordinary edges are geometry-only. Hypergraph-versus-ordinary changes construction/neighborhood/weights, so it is a propagation-control comparison, not isolation of only high-order structure. Identity retains region pooling/broadcast and learned nonlinear layers. Independent single branches have different parameter counts; primary-only dual control removes auxiliary-supervision confounding but does not equalize capacity.
